$$
\begin{aligned}\int {sec}^{2}x\,\text{d}x &= \tan x+C, \\ \int \sec x\tan x\,\text{d}x &= \sec x+C, \\ \int \csc x\cot x\,\text{d}x &= -\csc x+C.\end{aligned}
